:robot_face: *Hiring: Member of Technical Staff, Frontier Robotics Evals @ Robocurve*

<https://robocurve.org/|Robocurve> evaluates frontier AI robotics systems and informs the public on physical automation (i.e. "METR for robots"). We develop benchmarks and open-source tooling to evaluate AI on robots, working hands-on with real hardware (bimanual arms, humanoids, quadrupeds).
• :round_pushpin: In-person, SF
• :robot_face: No robotics background required, strong agentic coding skills (Claude Code, Codex) matter more
• :moneybag: $150k–$300k + equity (open to going higher for exceptional candidates)
• :link: <https://tally.so/r/1AQAlW|Apply here>
Know someone who'd be great for this? We're also offering $5k for successful <https://tally.so/r/0QqQPZ|referrals>.

---

Robocurve is founded by <@U0A046H3K96> (MATS scholar), we expect MATS scholars to be great fits for this role!

*[Hiring] AI Safety Research Scientist (Independent Research Project)*
We’re looking for an empirical AI safety research scientist to join our team in Cambridge/London on an independent AI safety research project.
*12-month contract · £90k salary · UK visa sponsorship available · Remote considered*
We’re studying how different alignment training interventions shape model behaviour, with projects on curriculum learning, on-/off-policy alignment, midtraining and model spec design.
We’re looking for someone with a strong AI safety background and a record of published AI safety research.
The project is funded by Coefficient Giving, with Meridian providing fiscal sponsorship and/or acting as the employer of record, depending on the successful candidate’s circumstances.
See the <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1L48xK5z0M4yJN3uwmcQU5Sxxn7b0yOoUy23b8VOeUJQ/edit?usp=sharing|job post> for details.
Apply via this <https://airtable.com/appL8qBpvd7dKMiGU/pags3e6dg8GUiKYmn/form|form> by 4 September.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and we aim to fill this role as soon as we find someone suitable.
